axes.name: Artifact creatures (Borg)
axes.definition: An artifact creature on your battlefield: Borg, Androids, Constructs, Robots, Illusions, artifact creature tokens, assimilated creatures and Spacecraft once stationed into creatures.

axes.name: Spacecraft & charge counters
axes.definition: A Spacecraft you cast or control, or an effect that puts charge counters on one, feeding cards that reward Spacecraft spells, Spacecraft on the battlefield or charge counters.

axes.name: Tapping your creatures
axes.definition: A repeatable way to tap your own creatures outside combat (station, tap-N-creatures costs, untap effects that let you tap again), feeding creatures with becomes-tapped triggers.

axes.name: Face a dilemma (modal spells)
axes.definition: A spell or ability whose modes you choose (choose one, choose two, named modes), each cast or activation facing one dilemma.

axes.name: Creatures dying & sacrifice
axes.definition: A creature or artifact you are happy to have die or sacrifice (creature tokens, dies-trigger creatures, end-step hasty tokens, Clues) or a sacrifice outlet that makes deaths happen, feeding death triggers and sacrifice payoffs.

axes.name: Landfall (lands entering)
axes.definition: A land entering under your control: land drops, searches that put lands onto the battlefield, Planet tokens, extra land drops and land bounce-and-replay.

axes.name: Strange new worlds (land names)
axes.definition: A land with a name you do not already control: Planets, Anomalies, dual lands, utility lands, a first Planet token, and searches that fetch them.

axes.name: +1/+1 and other counters
axes.definition: Putting a +1/+1 counter, or any counter including charge counters on a stationed Spacecraft, on a creature you control, feeding counter doublers and cards that reward creatures with counters.

axes.name: Go wide (total power 8+)
axes.definition: Extra bodies or power on your board at attack time: Officer and other creature tokens, anthems and team pumps, feeding attack-while-total-power-8-or-greater payoffs and Officer-count cards.

axes.name: Noncreature spells
axes.definition: A noncreature spell you cast: instant, sorcery, enchantment, Equipment, Spacecraft or other noncreature artifact, the cheaper and more numerous the better.

axes.name: Stocked graveyard
axes.definition: Putting your own cards into your graveyard by surveil, mill, looting and discard, cycling or creatures dying, feeding recursion, reanimation, threshold and cast-from-graveyard cards.

axes.name: Cards leaving your graveyard
axes.definition: An effect that moves a card out of your graveyard: beam me up casts, returning or reanimating cards, exiling or bottoming your own graveyard cards as a cost, feeding leaves-the-graveyard triggers.

axes.name: Enters triggers to rebuy
axes.definition: A permanent with an enters trigger worth repeating, feeding bounce, flicker, beam me up costs and trigger doublers.

axes.name: Creatures entering
axes.definition: A creature entering under your control, cast or token, feeding whenever-a-creature-enters payoffs that want many entries.

axes.name: Klingons
axes.definition: A Klingon creature or Klingon Warrior token you control, feeding cards that pump, count or sacrifice Klingons.

axes.name: Federation (creature type count)
axes.definition: A non-Borg creature adding new creature types to your board, multi-type creatures and typed tokens best, feeding Federation counts.

axes.name: Life gain
axes.definition: An effect that gains you life, including Planets entering, lifelink, Food and incidental drains, feeding whenever-you-gain-life and life-gained-this-turn payoffs.

corrections.reason: Bat'leth is a cheap Equipment whose entering turns on Sulu's becomes-tapped draw; Bat'leth already names Sulu as a partner.
Creates two 2/1 Klingon Warrior tokens with haste when X is 6 or more; the sorcery has no type:klingon fact so the axis is not supplied.
Untaps the target creature at instant speed for {G}, letting it be tapped again for station or a tap cost; Make It So's one-shot untap carries the same role.

A noncreature artifact spell; the artifact fact does not supply the axis, and every other noncreature artifact (Warp Core, Replicator, Engineered Explosives) carries it. Strength 1 because it costs 7.
A noncreature artifact spell; the artifact fact does not supply the axis, and the other noncreature artifacts carry it. Strength 1 because it costs 5.
Gives every creature with a counter "{T}: Add {G}", a repeatable way to tap your own creatures outside combat, like Rok-Tahk's grant (enabler 3) but limited to countered creatures.
Artifact spells are historic, so every artifact creature cast (Borg, Androids, Constructs, Illusions) draws a card; only the Spacecraft half of this is tagged.
